At our first appointment, Dr Szyszko put her unwashed, bare finger in my 6week pre-vaccinated baby’s mouth without asking permission or putting a glove on. Such a major infection control failing. She had been typing on the computer walking the hallway and touching several doorhandles prior to this. Should be reported to CQC! They also failed to follow up on referrals in a timely manner and I had to spend hours chasing things up with them myself. I am well aware of the pressure on the NHS and GP surgeries but patient care should always be prioritised. Just wash your hands. It’s not hard.
